ctx.x: To me, well, ahh with all due respect, because I am qualified to criticize anybody, we were more musical-advanced that what he had to produce because our arranger was to arranger and he was a well-inspired person, but you just can't I mean, compare Perez Prado with Chico O'Farrell, with Rene Hernandez, with Walter Fuller, with Edgar Samson ....
